answer: Answers carry a continuity bond. On submit the client computes a 16-byte pigment, H(answer ‖ prior_digest), locks 0.5% of balance behind it, and appends it to a chain bridging epochs. Auditors re-derive the pigment from stored text on 5% of seats; a mismatch slashes the bond and demotes the identity a tier. The chain flows one way like a river: after the next epoch opens an answer cannot be revised, so a farm cannot backfill or reuse templates without severing the bridge. N puppets require N distinct hashed answers per epoch, so cost grows linearly.
